This page documents mallard duck movement over time.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

mallards |>
  filter(lat >= 46, lat <= 55, long >= 7, long <= 25) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "#f0f0f0", color = "#888888") +
  geom_sf(aes(color = duck_id), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard GPS fixes",
    color = "Duck",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
